title: Flat flux identity: ∫ of D_eφ over the half-space {⟨y,e⟩ > 0} equals −∫_{e^⊥} φ dHⁿ
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, N := n + 1, ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), e ∈ ℝ^N with |e| = 1, H := {y ∈ ℝ^N : ⟨y, e⟩ > 0}, P := (span{e})^⊥ and Hⁿ := μHE[n] (Mathlib's Euclidean Hausdorff measure on ℝ^N). Let φ : ℝ^N → ℝ be C¹ with compact support. Then ∫_H Dφ(y)e dL^N(y) = −∫_P φ dHⁿ. Here Dφ(y)e = fderiv ℝ φ y e, L^N = volume, and ∫_H, ∫_P are integrals against the restricted measures L^N⌞H and Hⁿ⌞P.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (e : Rn (n + 1)) (φ : Rn (n + 1) → ℝ), ‖e‖ = 1 → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y in {y : Rn (n + 1) | 0 < inner ℝ y e}, fderiv ℝ φ y e = -∫ y in ((Submodule.span ℝ {e})ᗮ : Set (Rn (n + 1))), φ y ∂μHE[n]
